findings.claim: Matched test arms independently call begin and pay separate initial writer/reviewer/verifier chains; fixed1/legacy independently run the same initial writer prompt.
Training obtains one common initial state per question and clones it for measured action branches, then reuses successful depth-one children.
Each RoleAgents.generate creates a fresh SDK Agent with temperature zero and declared role cap; metadata UUID is an identity, not a seed.
Writer model is eval and generation explicitly uses do_sample=False, with no per-generation RNG seed.
All five CPU heads initialize under torch.manual_seed(seed); full-batch Adam and strict development improvement choose each seed's earliest best epoch.
Deployment seed selects a frozen head and cyclic arm order; separate runs independently recollect and fit all five heads.
The SDK role instances are distinct from the inherited team verifier. Runtime starts separate critic services and wraps a Critic with CPU evidence ranking.

limits: No source guarantee of identical independent greedy requests across hardware.

Seed1 is not an independently sampled writer run.
